policy: Reviewed source overrides for Poster ingredient IDs that were blocked by false/zero nutrition mappings. Generic references are documented explicitly and must not be treated as brand/cut-specific laboratory values.

entries.name: Говядина
entries.sourceReference: FDC 174757; beef composite of trimmed retail cuts, separable lean and fat, trimmed to 0 inch fat, all grades, raw
entries.notes: Poster ingredient name does not specify a cut. This is a documented USDA generic beef composite reference, not a cut-specific value.

entries.name: Говяжье суки
entries.sourceReference: FDC 171765; beef loin tenderloin roast, boneless, separable lean only, raw
entries.notes: Poster name 'суки' is treated as the local/Armenian usage for beef tenderloin (սուկի). Keep this mapping reviewable if the restaurant uses the name differently.

entries.name: Курица
entries.sourceReference: FDC 171447; chicken, broilers or fryers, meat and skin, raw
entries.notes: Generic whole chicken meat-and-skin reference because Poster ingredient does not specify a cut or skin removal.

entries.name: Куриная печень
entries.sourceReference: FDC 171060; chicken liver, all classes, raw

entries.name: Куриные сердечки
entries.sourceReference: FDC 171458; chicken heart, all classes, raw

entries.name: Куринный окорок /բուդ/
entries.sourceReference: FDC 172378; chicken, broilers or fryers, leg, meat and skin, raw
entries.notes: Poster name identifies chicken leg/thigh but does not say skinless; meat-and-skin reference is used.

entries.name: Куриный отвал
entries.sourceReference: FDC 171447; chicken, broilers or fryers, meat and skin, raw
entries.notes: Poster name denotes chicken trimming/offcuts and does not specify the originating cut or skin/fat ratio. A conservative generic raw chicken meat-and-skin reference is used; keep reviewable if the restaurant can provide a supplier specification.

entries.name: Печенье Юбилейное
entries.sourceReference: Юбилейное Традиционное 403 g; nutrition per 100 g: 463 kcal, protein 7.5 g, fat 18 g, carbohydrates 67 g
entries.notes: Used as the closest current Armenian retail label reference for the Poster ingredient 'Печенье Юбилейное'. Recheck if the restaurant uses another Юбилейное variety.
